help.customer360.intro: One customer's whole story: chats, leads, quotations, orders, payments and notes.

help.customer360.p2: Add a note, a task or a lead for them from here.

help.dialer.intro: Call a list of customers one after another, and note how each call went.

help.documents.intro: Your business files: catalogues, price lists, photos and PDFs.
help.documents.p1: Upload them once, then send them in chats or add them to quick replies.
help.faq.customerData.a: Open the customer and use Customer's data: "Download their data" makes one file to send them, and "Erase their data" removes it for good (tax invoices stay as long as the law asks). For a customer you deleted earlier, use Settings → Data & Privacy → A customer asked about their data. Answer within 90 days; the register there keeps when you did.
help.faq.customerData.q: A customer asked for their data, or to delete it. What do I do?
help.faq.data.a: Each company's data is kept apart, and a login can ask for a code from an authenticator app. Owners and admins can download all of the company's data at any time from Settings → Data & Privacy.
help.faq.data.q: Is my data safe, and can I download it?
help.faq.hindi.a: Press the half-circle button next to the bell at the top and choose हिंदी. It is saved for you on every device.
help.faq.hindi.q: How do I use the CRM in Hindi?
help.faq.import.a: Leads → Import (or Customers → Import) takes an Excel or CSV file. Check it first, then import; a customer who is already there is matched by mobile number.
help.faq.import.q: How do I bring in my old customers and leads?
help.faq.leadSources.a: Settings → Lead sources: connect IndiaMART with its CRM key, or put a form or a WhatsApp button on your website. New enquiries arrive in Leads by themselves.
help.faq.leadSources.q: How do IndiaMART and website enquiries come in?
help.faq.offline.a: Partly. Pages you opened before still open, and the Inbox shows the chats this phone saved. A reply you write waits on the phone and goes by itself — once — when the internet is back. New data, quotations and payments need the internet. Signing out deletes what the phone saved.
help.faq.offline.q: Does the CRM work without internet?
help.faq.payment.a: Connect Razorpay or Cashfree in Settings → Payments, then send a payment link from an order or a chat. Once it is paid, the order is marked paid by itself.
help.faq.phone.a: Yes: open it in your phone's browser, then put it on your home screen with the half-circle button at the top → Install the app (on an iPhone: Share → Add to Home Screen). It then opens like an app, straight to your Inbox. To log in on a computer quickly, open the CRM there and scan its code from your phone (Settings → Your Profile).
help.faq.phone.q: Does the CRM work on a phone?
help.faq.plan.a: Settings → Plan & usage shows your plan, what you use and your bills; you can upgrade from there.
help.faq.plan.q: How do I see or change my plan?
help.faq.quotation.a: Quotations → + New: choose the customer and the products, then send it. The customer gets a PDF on WhatsApp, and you see when they open it.
help.faq.quotation.q: How do I send a quotation on WhatsApp?
help.faq.status.a: Nothing is lost. If WhatsApp (Meta) is in trouble, the message shows a clock and goes by itself when it is back. If it failed, the chat shows why, with Try again. Owners and admins see everything that did not go in Settings → Failed sends, and anyone can see what is working on the status page.
help.faq.status.q: My message did not go, or WhatsApp seems down. What do I do?
help.faq.team.a: Settings → Team & Access: invite them. Each person signs in with Google and sees only the pages you allow.
help.faq.team.q: How do I add my staff?
help.faq.whatsapp.a: Settings → WhatsApp: connect it in a few steps with Meta. Your number keeps working in the WhatsApp Business app on your phone, and the chats also come into the Inbox.
help.faq.whatsapp.q: How do I connect my WhatsApp number?

xl.feed.hint: Live data for your own sheets and dashboards: each table has one web address. Make an API key above that may read that table, then follow the steps. Refresh pulls the latest data.
xl.feed.more: Money is in rupees and dates are dates. Add &updatedSince=2026-10-01 for only what changed since then; leave out format=csv for JSON. Up to 1,00,000 rows a table.
xl.feed.pbi.2: Paste the address; add the HTTP request header Authorization = Bearer <your API key>.
xl.feed.pbi.3: Load, build your report, and use Refresh for the latest data.
